description: Vulnerabilidade a Inundações is a series of datasets listed in Brazilian national water resources information system metadata catalogue (SNIRH), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Agência Nacional de Águas e Saneamento Básico (ANA, SNIRH). Trechos de curso d'água inundáveis com os atributos de ottocodificação, frequência de ocorrência, grau de impacto e vulnerabilidade a inundações graduais. Coverage: Brasil. The portal lists 42 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its tags are trechos de curso d'água inundáveis, inundação gradual, vulnerabilidade a inundações, frequência de ocorrência, grau de impacto. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-snirh-portal.
